text:
luisa: Observed a cluster of clients stuck at 'connecting' after edge idle (10s) cut. Some get 429s, others hang.
dan: saw a 3x reconnect spike and matching 429s from global limiter. Proxy logs point to suppression flag persisting.
omar: snippet: `2026-03-24T11:05:01Z proxy.INFO session_close id=zzz idle=10; proxy.DEBUG suppress_set fp=abc ttl=30000; limiter.WARN check fp=abc status=429; proxy.INFO handshake_reject reason=suppression_active`
luisa: suppress_session_window was added to prevent duplicate billing. But looks like a race: rate-limiter returns 429 before suppression gets reconciled, leaving clients suppressed longer
dan: mitigation: canary feature-flag to drop suppression window 30s->3s for edge-canary. Risk: small duplicate bill chance.
omar: longer term: make suppression lifecycle atomic (CAS) or ensure error paths clear suppression. Also surface suppression as connection reason in console so support can see it
deploy-bot: Canaries: FF-400 suppress_session_window_ms 30000->3000 on edge-canary (5% -> 25% over 10m)
luisa: actions:
- dan: run telemetry to estimate duplicate billing (P1)
- omar: implement CAS fix (P0)
- luisa: add console mapping and suppression chart (P0)
deploy-bot: canary started. Monitoring suppression_count, 429_rate, duplicate_billing_estimate
dan: will post telemetry in ~30m.
